chapter_meta_description: In a mythic clash between two stone-man kings, Pangu's projection nearly destroys the old king, who resurrects via a forbidden chant. Allies scramble to steal the ninety-nine stone steps and witness a new stone man's emergence.
og_title: Clash of the Stone Kings: Pangu's Wrath and the Forbidden Revival
og_description: Two primordial stone kings battle across time and space. The old king summons his past peak, while Ge Qian and Keke's father unleash new divine principles. A new stone man rises from the divine city.
